lines.t: Searching for the wellspring, the center of all things
Fall to my knees, heart open, let the spirit sing
All around is shadow, but I thirst for holy flame
Empty myself just to rise in your name
Bonds break when surrender is real
Your love conquered, now I finally fail
I wanted my way, price had like stone
You shattered those idols, claimed me for your own
Now the old man dies, light breaks through
I chase after nothing but the truth of you
Learning to trust means letting go
Mercy flows deepest when we're brought low
Show me how to walk
Strong but contrite
Obedience over sacrifice
Spirit takes flight
Self on the altar
Deny what I crave
Buried in your love from the pit you saved
Love is a choice, not just a word
Echo through my actions
Make your heartbeat hurt
Set apart, I move against
The current tide
Humble in weakness, I let the old self slide
Loving you above all, the love in the least
Feeding the hungry, forgiving the beast
Trumpet your words, unashamed in this night
Bearing your standard, living for what's right
Abide in your love
Not just for now
Surrender my ruin
Receive holy power
Footsteps aligned, I walk where you trod
Your law engraved deeper than flesh or facade
This is my anthem, a witness, a call
Lay down my life so your glory stands tall
Let waves of your love break every chain
Till all that remains is Yahushua's reign
Thanks for watching!
